UNITED STATES DISTRICT COURT
FOR THE EASTERN DISTRICT OF VIRGINIA
ALEXANDRIA DIVISION

MARVELLE J. BALLENTINE, Plaintiff, v. KATIE HALL, individually; NATIONAL CENTER FOR MISSING & EXPLOITED CHILDREN; META PLATFORMS, INC.; and JOHN/JANE DOES 1–6, Defendants. ____________________________________/ | Case No. 1:26-cv-02331

NOTICE OF WAIVER OF ORAL ARGUMENT AND REQUEST FOR PROMPT DETERMINATION ON THE PAPERS (PLAINTIFF’S ADMINISTRATIVE MOTION FOR EXPEDITED BRIEFING, PRIORITY DETERMINATION, AND A DEFINED DECISION SCHEDULE FOR THE TWO RULE 26(d)(1) APPLICATIONS)

1.	Plaintiff Marvelle J. Ballentine waives oral argument on Plaintiff’s Administrative Motion for Expedited Briefing, Priority Determination, and a Defined Decision Schedule for the Two Rule 26(d)(1) Applications, submitted [date] (ECF No. [___]) (the “Administrative Motion”), under Local Civil Rule 7(J). Plaintiff requests that the Court direct determination of the Administrative Motion on the papers under Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 78(b) and Local Civil Rules 7(E) and 7(J), promptly after service on all appearing parties and, if the Court requires administrative submissions, immediately after the Administrative Motion becomes submitted under Proposed Interim Order 4C.

2.	This Notice is filed with the Administrative Motion in accordance with the Clerk’s Office General Filing Tips for the Alexandria Division, item 9. It contains no hearing date and requests no hearing setting. Plaintiff’s waiver does not itself create a submission arrangement; Plaintiff requests an order directing submission on the papers.

3.	Plaintiff requests court-directed paper submission whether or not counsel agrees. [Complete from the November 9, 2026 conferral: Counsel for NCMEC and Hall stated ___ concerning determination of the Administrative Motion on the papers. Counsel for Meta stated ___. If either counsel stated no position, say so. Do not state consent or opposition that was not expressed.] If any counsel does not agree to determination on the papers, Plaintiff maintains this waiver and requests that the Court determine submission under Local Civil Rule 7(J). The Court retains authority to direct oral argument; Plaintiff does not request it.

4.	This Notice concerns the Administrative Motion only. Each of the two Applications identified in the Administrative Motion carries its own waiver. This Notice does not withdraw any objection Plaintiff has stated to the termination of earlier hearing settings, does not request restoration of the December 16, 2026 setting, and does not treat the docket entry of November 5, 2026, which governs the motions then set, as deciding, scheduling, or allocating either Application.

Date: __________, 2026		                      Respectfully submitted,

Marvelle J. Ballentine

Plaintiff, pro se
